PrimoFit Flow External Urine Management for the Male Anatomy

Confident care for urinary incontinence

PrimoFit Flow is designed to effectively manage urinary incontinence, helping to support
patient comfort and streamline workflow.

text.text:
Advancing urinary incontinence care

PrimoFit Flow uses continuous suction to support early catheter removal while keeping patients comfortable. It serves as an alternative to external collection devices or, when appropriate, indwelling catheters and addresses the #1 risk factor of catheter-associated urinary tract infections (CAUTI).1

  • Can be left in place for up to 24 hours
  • Convenient time/date label encourages compliance to protocol
  • Blue liners are easy to see after removal to reduce the risk of misplacement
  • Tiered suction tubing adapter connects to hospital suction tubing
  • Semi-closed top reduces the risk of leakage while maintaining airflow
  • Reorder #5406

text_1051646430_copy.text:
Supporting care and efficiency 

Designed with both caregivers and patients in mind, this system helps streamline workflow and supports patient comfort. A skin-friendly, ultra-soft fabric helps divert urine away from the skin, while transparent film allows for ongoing skin assessment. Together, these features support effective management of male urinary incontinence – while also addressing the essential needs of application, securement and performance.

standaloneimage_copy.alt: PromFit Flow's split adhesive for application and removal

text.text:
Easy to apply

  • Customizable fit eliminates the need for sizing charts and split liner helps make application easy
  • Adhesive pad and base adhesive are skin-friendly and allow for easy application and removal

standaloneimage_copy.alt: An illustration of the PrimoFit Flow staying in place on male anatomy

text_copy.text:
Stays in place 

  • Clear flex adhesive contours to patient anatomy and stays in place even when anatomy causes tension within the device
  • 2-layer design promotes breathability to aid securement

standaloneimage_copy.alt: Medical illustration of urine being diverted through the PrimoFit Flow external urine management device

text_copy.text:
Diverts urine

  • Foam stabilizer supports the bottom of the device to promote continuous urine diversion
  • Provides urine output in the side-lying position and if twisting occurs

text_1051646430_copy.text:
Help address the risk of CAUTI

Your bed-bound patients deserve the best possible care when it comes to urine management.

text.text: Approximately 75% of hospital-acquired urinary tract infections are associated with an indwelling urinary catheter.1

standaloneimage_copy.alt: Icon of a stick figure in a hospital bed

text_copy.text: It’s estimated that 10-25% of acute care hospitalized patients and 7.5-10% of patients in long-term care facilities are catheterized at any one time.4
Each day the indwelling urinary catheter remains, a patient has a 3-7% increased risk of acquiring a CAUTI.3

text.text: Replace PrimoFit Flow at least every 24 hours, or sooner if soiled with stool or bodily fluids other than urine. Dispose of the device per hospital protocol and local regulations.

text_copy.text: Replace tubing and empty and/or replace suction canister per hospital protocol.
PrimoFit Flow is designed to divert urine away from a patient into a suction canister using low continuous suction. It is not designed to be connected to a gravity-dependent drainage bag.
Set vacuum to low, continuous suction at a minimum of 60 mmHg. Always use the minimum amount of suction necessary.

text.text: PrimoFit Flow may be complementary to an early mobility program. PrimoFit Flow is designed to serve as a transition between an immobile patient who requires an indwelling urinary catheter to a mobile patient who is able to ambulate to the commode or bathroom. The devices should be assessed by medical and nursing staff and discontinued when independent or assisted toileting is feasible and during patient ambulation.

text_copy.text: No need to add water. The cloths come pre-moistened and ready to use.
No. Comfort Shield Barrier Cream Cloths are compatible with antifungal products.4

The standby life of the included battery is four years if installed on a device that is not used. The battery will provide 166 200 joule shocks (with one minute of CPR between shocks) or 103 360 joule shocks (with one minute of CPR between shocks) or 800 minutes of operating time.
